name: Trae
desc: 国产首个 AI 原生集成开发环境
desc_zh: 国产首个 AI 原生集成开发环境
solves: AI features only add up after installing a pile of plugins, and the result is a mess. Trae builds the coding assistant into the editor.
solves_zh: AI 功能要装一堆插件才凑得齐，拼起来很乱。Trae 把编码助手直接做进编辑器里。
best_for: When you want an AI coding environment that works out of the box, without assembling plugins yourself.
best_for_zh: 想要一个开箱即用的 AI 编程环境，不想自己拼插件。
